notificationsHub.title: Notification Command Center
notificationsHub.description: One place to manage every server-facing notification feed: live streams, uploads, game news, patch notes, anime episodes, and birthday announcements.
notificationsHub.twitchDescription: Stream alerts with destination channels, custom messages, cooldowns, and quiet hours.
notificationsHub.tiktokDescription: Creator live alerts using the same channel routing and notification controls as Twitch.
notificationsHub.blueskyDescription: Account post alerts with Discord channel routing, custom messages, cooldowns, and quiet hours.
notificationsHub.youtubeDescription: Watch channels for new uploads and post clean video announcements to Discord.
notificationsHub.steamDescription: Official Steam game announcements with destination channels, custom messages, cooldowns, and quiet hours.
notificationsHub.patchDescription: Subscribe channels to game update feeds so patch posts land where people expect them.
notificationsHub.animeDescription: AniList search, season browsing, and channel reminders for upcoming episodes.
notificationsHub.birthdayDescription: Member birthday announcements with member search and per-birthday destination channels.
notificationsHub.importReadFailed: Failed to read notification setup import.
notificationsHub.previewDescription: Missing supported routes can be created without overwriting existing notification setup.
notificationsHub.noReady: No missing supported routes were found.
notificationsHub.reviewDescription: Duplicate routes, cross-channel feed overlap, and high-volume notification channels.
notificationsHub.reviewClean: No duplicate notification routes or crowded destination channels were detected.
